description: Exhaustion level 6: every D20 Test is reduced by 12, and your Speed by 30 feet. You die at level 6.
_comment: SRD 5.2.1, Rules Glossary > Exhaustion. One effect per level; systems::exhaustion swaps them as the level changes, so the penalties never stack twice. D20 Tests are skill checks (initiative included), saving throws and attack rolls.
